summary: Send a website OTP by SMS
description: Sends a one-time code (Twilio Verify) to an **Indian mobile number** (any common spelling; normalised to E.164) for the lead forms. `name` is accepted for legacy forms and not stored. Backend `LEADS_OTP_BACKEND`: `twilio` in staging/prod; `fake` in dev/test (no SMS, the code is always `000000` — the dev default in `flarize/settings/dev.py` and `.env.docker.example`). Non-Indian/landline numbers → 400 `otp_phone_unsupported`; more than 10 sends per number in 24 h (DB cap, `LEADS_OTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_PHONE_PER_DAY`) or a Twilio 429 → 429 `otp_limit_reached`; provider unconfigured/unreachable → 503 `otp_unavailable`; Twilio rejects the number → 400 `otp_send_failed`. The code expires after 600 s.

auth.notes: Anonymous. Throttles (replace the default `public_write`): `otp` 5/10min per normalised phone number (falls back to client IP when the body has no valid number) and `otp_ip` 20/10min per client IP; both fail open on a cache outage (the DB cap still holds). Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

description: Runs the engineering checker (ACTIVE checker rule set, current PriceRelease) on the BOM lines and stores the verdict as an engineering run **whether or not the lock succeeds**. Refused with 409 `bom_lock_refused` (errors: `engineering_run`, `blocked`, `missing_acknowledgements`) while a BLOCK finding is unwaived (engineering waives under `engineering/findings/<uid>/acknowledge/`) or a WARN finding that needs one has no acknowledgement (`{rule_code, reason}`). On success the snapshot (lines with list price/landed cost, verdict, acknowledgements) is frozen into `bom_lock` and the project moves PLANNED → IN_PROGRESS; it is never unlocked. Also 409 `bom_already_locked`, `invalid_transition` (not PLANNED), `no_active_rule_set`; 400 `validation_error` for unknown component uids. `bom_lock` line `unit_landed_cost` and `cost_inputs` are null without `pricing_internal.view`. `expected_version` is optional (409 `stale_version` when outdated).
